## About the Job

SummaryFull posting

### Requirements

- Proven experience building revenue or GTM operations at a high-growth technology company, with a track record of building systems from zero to one.
- Deep, hands-on HubSpot architecture and administration.
- Salesforce experience a plus.
- A systems-engineering orientation: you design data models, build CRM, ERP (NetSuite or similar), and BI integrations, and automate rather than work by hand.
- Comfortable with BI and analytics tools Looker, Tableau, Sigma, or similar, and SQL; Python a plus.
- Experience with modern automation and AI tooling for GTM (n8n, Zapier, Clay, AI agents).
- Strong forecasting, pipeline, and revenue analytics, including bookings, backlog, and revenue reconciliation.
- A high-agency operator who brings structure to ambiguity and partners well across finance, GTM, supply chain, operations, and engineering.
- Familiarity with multi-entity, multi-currency operating models and the data governance that keeps them clean.

### Responsibilities

- Own the GTM tech stack end to end: HubSpot, its integration to NetSuite, and the BI layer on top.
- Architect the CRM data model so every deal is structured for clean reporting and revenue recognition (contract type, legal entity, revenue segment, probability of win).
- Stand up the pipeline-to-backlog-to-revenue bridge across entity, contract type, and product line.
- Connect contract awards to delivery with a milestone tracker that feeds the revenue recognition schedule.
- Enforce data quality at the point of entry through validation and automation, using modern tooling like n8n and Clay.
- Keep data flowing across CRM, ERP, product catalog, and analytics through integrations you build and maintain.
- Build the forecasting and pipeline models, and the executive and board reporting that runs on them.
- Put data governance and an audit-ready trail in place for a clean month-end close and external or DCAA audits.
- Maintain multi-entity, multi-currency workflows in the systems: entity attribution, intercompany flags, consistent FX logic.
- Partner across finance, supply chain, operations, engineering, and the GTM team to align the full deal-to-delivery motion.
- Standardize pipeline stages and qualification criteria with objective exit signals.
- Lead enablement and change management as new processes and tools roll out, and earn the trust of sellers, finance, and leadership.

### Desired Qualifications

- Experience in defense or government environments (FAR/DFARS, ITAR) and government contract vehicles (IDIQ, OTA, BAA, FFP, CPFF).
- Experience in a hardware, manufacturing, or combined hardware-and-software business strongly preferred.

Auterion is in hyper-growth mode, and we're building the revenue operating system to scale with us. We're hiring a Revenue Operations Manager to design and own it, building the GTM systems from the ground up and connecting pipeline, delivery, and revenue into infrastructure the whole company runs on.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to do career-defining work. You'll stand up the revenue operations function from scratch and own it as we scale, on a business model more interesting than most: hardware and software, sold to commercial and government customers worldwide.

You'll operate with real autonomy under the office of the CFO, with Finance as your closest partner and a direct line to the leaders running GTM. The job is equal parts technical and strategic: you'll architect the data model and automations, size pipeline coverage, and build the forecast leadership runs on.

### [Auterion](https://simplify.jobs/c/Auterion)

Open-source drone software for fleet management

Auterion provides a software platform to power and manage autonomous drone fleets. It combines open-source components (like AuterionOS, Auterion Suite, Auterion Mission Control, and Auterion Skynode X) to let users control multiple drones from a single interface, visualize and process data in real time, and automate workflows. The platform is designed for drone manufacturers, enterprises, and developers who need scalable, integrated fleet management for use cases such as mapping, delivery, and surveillance. Auterion differentiates itself by relying on open-source software, contributing to PX4 and Pixhawk, and forming partnerships to add features (e.g., 5G and AI) to its stack. The company’s goal is to enable efficient, scalable autonomous drone operations across industries by fostering an open ecosystem and providing comprehensive fleet management tools.
